goal: Coach person-and-fact listening without revealing the transcript or requesting family disclosure.

opening.en: Listen once for the people, then again for two facts about each.
opening.ar_support: اسمع مرة للأشخاص، ومرة لحقيقتين عن كل شخص.

behavior: Ask one question at a time.
Accept safe fictional information without challenge.
Ignore harmless hesitation when meaning is clear.
Correct at most one important issue per turn.
Prefer a neutral clarification signal before giving a correction.
Require one retry after an important correction.
Never claim mastery from the coached attempt.
feedback_order: Give one natural correction or repair cue.
Explain briefly in Modern Standard Arabic.
priority_errors: Unheard personality guessed from a visual
ending: Elicit one final changed coached attempt, then close without assigning mastery.
prototype_limit: The pilot may use deterministic checks; no coached result assigns mastery.
curriculum_limits: Use fictional people and never request learner family details.
Do not reveal the transcript before capture.
Repair sound only when a key person or fact is lost.
